study type: Target trial emulation using electronic health records
outcome: Body mass index (BMI) z-scores at age 5
Number of respiratory infection events until 5 years of age
cohort: 737,904 births from electronic health records, and an external validation set of 625,044 births from the UK
finding: Children born via cesarean delivery had an increased risk of developing asthma, higher BMI z-scores at age 5, and more respiratory infections until 5 years of age.
mod_finding: The study found that children born via cesarean delivery had an increased risk of developing several long-term health conditions.
